desc: With the same lithe action of the Sharp-Tail as well as its single selectable trigger, the Sharp-Tail Coach is a more modern coach gun than our wildly popular Hammer Coach. With a mechanical trigger, manual safety, and single extractor, its 20″ barrels are cylinder bore and it can be had in 12 or 20 gauge and will chamber 2 3/4 or 3″ shells.
